title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Reconciliation Standard: Credit Owed on a Merchandise Purchases Refund
content:
**Standard.** For a notice that a Marlowe & Finch refund settled to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account has not been credited, the refund in question is the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund record settled to the Marlowe & Finch card tender, as kept in the Merchandise Purchases records (the refund record's amount, date and the purchase it refunds, and that purchase's order number). The credit owed is set by comparing the refund record with the card: when card credits that name the refund record have posted but total less than the refund, the credit owed is the refund less those credits; when no card credit names it and the refund is larger than the card purchase postings of the refunded order, the credit owed is those purchase postings; in every other case the credit owed stays the amount of the refund record. A refund whose card credits already total at least the refund is not the subject of such a notice, and nothing is owed.

## Comparison table

| Card credits naming the refund record | Refund against the card purchase postings of the refunded order | Credit owed |
|---|---|---|
| posted, total below the refund | any | the refund less those credits |
| none | refund larger | the total of those purchase postings |
| none | refund not larger | the refund amount |
| posted, total at least the refund | any | nothing; not the subject of such a notice |

## Cases (hypothetical Merchandise Purchases refunds)

| Refund record | Card credits naming it | Card purchase postings of the refunded order | Credit owed |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 150.00 | USD 100.00 | USD 150.00 | USD 50.00 |
| USD 150.00 | none | USD 120.00 | USD 120.00 |
| USD 100.00 | none | USD 120.00 | USD 100.00 |
| USD 120.00 | none | USD 120.00 | USD 120.00 |
| USD 150.00 | USD 150.00 | USD 150.00 | nothing |
